documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.description: Your 12-digit Aadhaar number or card (e-Aadhaar from uidai.gov.in also works).

documents.name: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
documents.description: Needed to receive the OTP. Update it at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra if it is not linked.

documents.name: Bank account details / passbook
documents.description: Account number and IFSC code, usually printed on the first page of the passbook.

documents.name: Passport-size photo
documents.description: Recent colour photo with a plain background.

documents.name: Address proof
documents.description: Aadhaar, voter ID, electricity bill, rent agreement or ration card with your current address.

documents.name: Age proof
documents.description: Aadhaar, birth certificate, school leaving certificate, PAN or passport.

documents.name: PAN card
documents.description: Permanent Account Number. Some banks ask for it, or Form 60 if you do not have PAN.

documents.name: Learner's licence
documents.description: You must hold it for at least 30 days before the driving test.

documents.name: Medical certificate (Form 1-A)
documents.description: From a registered doctor. Needed if you are 40 or older, or for a commercial / transport licence.

documents.name: Ration card
documents.description: Shows your family is listed under the National Food Security Act or a state scheme.

documents.name: Aadhaar of all family members
documents.description: Aadhaar numbers of everyone to be added to the card.

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.description: Issued by the tehsil / revenue office. Some states ask for it for ration cards.

documents.name: Proof of platform work
documents.description: Partner ID screenshot, payout statements or ID card from the platform or contractor.

goals.name: e-Shram registration
steps: Open eshram.gov.in and choose 'Register on e-Shram'.
Enter your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and verify with OTP.
Enter your Aadhaar number and verify with OTP.
Fill address, education, occupation and bank account details.
Submit and download your e-Shram (UAN) card. Registration is free; a CSC can help at no cost.

goals.name: Open a bank account (Jan Dhan)
steps: Go to any bank branch or a Bank Mitra (business correspondent) near you.
Ask for a Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) zero-balance savings account.
Fill the account opening form and give your Aadhaar for e-KYC.
If you have no PAN, fill Form 60 instead.
Collect your passbook and RuPay debit card.

goals.name: Driving licence
steps: Apply for a learner's licence online on the Parivahan Sarathi service (parivahan.gov.in) and pay the fee.
Pass the online or RTO learner's licence test.
After 30 days (and within 6 months), apply for the permanent driving licence.
Book a slot and take the driving test at the RTO with your vehicle.
The licence is sent to your address; you can also use the DigiLocker copy.

goals.name: Ayushman card (PM-JAY)
steps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app and log in with your mobile number.
Search your name by state and Aadhaar / ration card to check eligibility.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC with OTP or fingerprint.
Download the Ayushman card once it is approved.
Or visit a CSC or the Ayushman Mitra desk at an empanelled hospital for help.

goals.name: PAN card
steps: Open incometax.gov.in and choose 'Instant e-PAN'.
Enter your Aadhaar number and verify with the OTP sent to your linked mobile.
Check your details and submit; the e-PAN is free.
Download the e-PAN PDF after a short time using your acknowledgement number.

goals.name: Ration card
steps: Ration cards are issued by your state Food & Civil Supplies department. Find your state portal from nfsa.gov.in.
Fill the new ration card form online or at the food office / CSC.
Add all family members with their Aadhaar numbers.
Submit documents; an inspector may verify your address.
Track the application status on the state portal.
